PIN-assisted encryption compatibility test

This isolated test uses a fixed synthetic message. Do not enter a GitHub token here.

Enrollment creates a test passkey in the provider you choose. Select a provider offering a PIN. Only encrypted test data and public credential metadata are stored by this fixture.

  1. Enroll and encrypt. Complete the browser/provider prompts yourself.
  2. After success, fully exit and restart Chrome. Return to this extension's Options page.
  3. Choose Unlock and verify, and complete the PIN prompt yourself.

Ready. No real credentials are needed.

After testing, remove this fixture from Chrome. Remove its test passkey separately from the provider if desired; uninstalling an extension does not delete a passkey.
